title: Publish v0.5.57 and verify future-adopter delivery
rawUserRequest: 完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。目标是把收益交付给 adopter；发布最新版本为止，做好优化和自检；明天要看到修正完整的新版本（包括远程和本地清理）。

acceptance: A successful same-SHA v0.5.57 release rehearsal receipt exists before publication is dispatched.
The provider release publishes immutable tag v0.5.57 from the final origin/main SHA with all required source-bound assets and evidence.

guidelines: Provider publication is authorized only for v0.5.57 and only after all exact-source gates pass.
Do not weaken coverage, test collection, security, smoke, compatibility, release, or evidence gates.
Treat provider assets and a fresh installation as the authority for adopter delivery.

intent.problem: The performance and installer-repair capability has merged to main but future adopters cannot receive it until immutable v0.5.57 provider assets are released and a real full-HTTPS installation proves the release projection is consistent.
constraints: Do not change, delete, move, or republish existing versions including v0.5.56.
Do not bypass rehearsal, strict smoke, compatibility, asset, source-binding, coverage, or public distribution verification.
A release failure must remain red/yellow with recovery evidence; no chat-only success claim.
Close Issue #783 only after fresh black-box proof and record the proof in the Work Item Summary.
intent.rationale: A release workflow binds the final default-branch source to immutable provider assets, while a clean external installation is the only credible proof that future adopter projects receive the repaired installer and performance capability.
